RULING on #2618 (05:45): option (b), scoped to #2618 ONLY.
Main is red, the PR is test-only (+8 lines), and a fresh standard reviewer approved 7af1721cf0.
Post that review on the PR as a comment now: 'REVIEW (merge): APPROVE at 7af1721cf0 ... verdict recording blocked by an expired seat grant; to be recorded after operator re-entry'.
Then merge pinned (--match-head-commit 7af1721cf0b098c8b1c99398a7d3f3964a9f64b3) once Build is green.
Record the verdict as soon as your grant is renewed.
Every OTHER merge (#2614 r3, #2602, #2598, #2601, #2611, #2617) waits for the renewed grant and recorded verdicts. This is not a general waiver.
The grant fix: I am asking the operator to re-enter integrator in a terminal and restart the merge relay from that shell. Write a clean handoff now so the restart loses nothing.
subject: Ruling #2618: merge on green w/ PR-comment approval; others wait for grant
